upstream.p23_abm_accounting: Accepted synthetic accounting and explicit catalogue gaps only.
upstream.p31_censoring_identifiability: Censoring, event-time and identifiability limitations remain explicit.
upstream.p33_sampling: Cohort eligibility, decision-time observability and measurement missingness remain separate from clinical state.
upstream.p33_uncertainty: Within-run, parameter, data and structural uncertainty remain distinct; empirical ED ranges remain unknown.

time_accounting_contract.unit_of_accounting: one named entity's one event timeline with explicit start/end boundary and source event IDs
time_accounting_contract.macro_elapsed_rule: For a complete uncensored timeline, macro elapsed equals the sum of nonoverlapping micro components in that same entity/event timeline. Do not add another actor's concurrent intervals to it.
time_accounting_contract.intrinsic_work_rule: Intrinsic active work includes active_work only. Setup, transit, queue_or_wait, interruption and handover retain their own types and cannot be silently added to active work.
time_accounting_contract.service_fit_rule: Fit each declared estimand from its named component(s); a total task/service estimand must state whether setup is included. Never fit one undifferentiated elapsed interval as both intrinsic service and transit/wait.
time_accounting_contract.concurrent_actor_rule: A staff movement interval may overlap a patient's wait on a separate actor timeline; it is linked by task/event ID but is not summed again into the patient macro elapsed or intrinsic-work total.
time_accounting_contract.censoring_rule: An incomplete/censored interval has no fabricated end or completed duration; retain status, last-known time, censor reason and source lineage.
time_accounting_contract.missingness_rule: A missing interval is not a zero-duration component. Unknown type/end stays unknown and cannot be imputed from a different component without an explicit reviewed method.

invented_accounting_fixture.purpose: Exercise component accounting and actor separation only; all numeric values are invented sentinels.

concurrent_staff_timeline.rule: This staff movement occurs during patient waiting and is not added to the patient timeline's macro or active-work total.

retained_sampling_and_cohort_gates: Arrival mode is generated for an eligible arrival before mode-conditioned choices; unknown/missing mode has no conditional draw until explicitly resolved.
Observed ATS-like numerators, emergency-arrival denominator, valid-record denominator, unknown code and missing records are cohort-keyed and reconciled separately.
Measurement event_time, available_at and recorded_at do not replace latent/known/recorded/realized state separation or license future information in an earlier decision.
sampling_gate_evidence: Arrival-mode conditioning, ATS-like denominator reconciliation and missingness-versus-priority behavioural tests are accepted in P3.3.sampling; this join leaf retains those boundaries but does not duplicate or claim that test coverage.
nonclaims: No ED active-work, setup, transit, wait, interruption or handover duration is estimated or selected.
This is an accounting contract fixture, not a DES/ABM runtime implementation, calibration result, operational pathway, or validated site profile.
Macro/micro accounting cannot resolve source-data identifiability, censoring, transfer, population or local operational evidence gaps.
